recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central mathematical division symbol rendered in thick, black impasto paint against a vibrant cyan and light blue radial spin-art background. The background consists of energetic, streaky lines radiating from the center, while the symbol itself has rough, organic edges and visible brushstroke textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial background lines converging behind the central horizontal bar
High contrast between deep black foreground and bright cyan background
Organic, uneven edges of the geometric symbol against the sharp, linear background streaks
Vertical symmetry of the two circular dots around the central bar
coreInvariants: Heavy black paint texture for the central symbol
Rough, hand-drawn quality of the division sign components

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The division symbol is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick, horizontal black bar in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central bar, move outward following the radial streaks, then return to the two black dots above and below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The cyan background acts as active negative space, providing directional energy rather than static rest.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan and light blue radial streaks (Background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White highlights within the radial streaks
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation cyan paired with absolute black creates a striking, modern contrast.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters appear as if etched into the black paint or applied with a very fine white pen

composition.position: Centered on the horizontal black bar
composition.overlap: Layered on top of black paint

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single handwritten style to maintain a raw, personal aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the thin, deliberate but organic stroke

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a radial spin-art background using cyan, light blue, and white acrylic paint. The streaks should radiate from the center to the edges. Overlap this with a large, central division symbol (a horizontal bar and two dots) rendered in thick, textured black impasto paint with rough, organic edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, white, hand-lettered uppercase text centered horizontally within the black bar. The lettering should look like it was scratched into the paint or written with a fine-tip white marker, featuring wide spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background a radial burst of cyan and white?
Is the division symbol thick, black, and textured?
Is the text white, thin, and centered on the bar?
Does the overall image feel like a physical painting?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the black impasto paint
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black paint looks 'heavy' and layered over the blue.
Check that the radial lines converge exactly behind the center of the bar.
Verify the text is legible but maintains a raw, hand-drawn quality.
Confirm the cyan color is vibrant and not muted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color] radial spin-art background with a [Symbol] rendered in [Contrast Color] impasto paint, featuring [Hand-drawn Text] centered within the primary shape.
